name: Definition & meaning

aiExposure.unit: % of queries with an AI Overview (Seer 'question' class — mapping approximate)

evidence.finding: Definition markers scored +57% citation influence; definition-type semantic roles ranked highest alongside comparison.
Fan-out turns 'what is X' into sub-queries; one strong definition page absorbs them (anti-scaled-abuse).

notes: Definition-first paragraphs are the cheapest quotable unit — the glossary play.

name: How-to & guidance

aiExposure.unit: % of queries with an AI Overview (Seer 'question' class); Authoritas measured 'problem solving' 74% / 'specific question' 69% trigger rates

evidence.finding: Problem-solving keywords trigger AI Overviews 74% of the time — the highest measured intent class.

notes: Numbered steps are the extraction format; every step should survive alone as a passage.

name: Comparison & alternatives

aiExposure.unit: % of queries with an AI Overview (Seer comparison class — the highest)

evidence.finding: Comparison questions carry the highest mean citation influence of any question type; comparison content scored +55%.
For 100 B2B SaaS 'best [category]' queries, third-party best-of lists earn 63% of citations vs 17% for vendor pages — you must appear in lists you don't own.
Commercial-intent queries send 40.86% of citations to listicles.

notes: The sharpest industry-independent pattern in the whole atlas: comparison queries are where AI answers live and where third-party lists beat own pages.

name: Transactional & pricing

aiExposure.unit: % of queries with an AI Overview (Seer transactional class — the lowest)

evidence.finding: AI Overviews appear on 29.9% of keywords but only 11.5% of search volume — transactional volume is largely untouched by AIO.
Pricing pages are extraction targets: engines get asked 'how much does X cost', and screenshots are invisible — put real numbers in text.

notes: Low AIO exposure ≠ low GEO value: pricing/brand questions still get answered by assistants, just not via AIO SERPs.

name: Topic research & education

aiExposure.unit: % of queries with an AI Overview (Seer informational class); Authoritas 'topic research' 3.4%

evidence.finding: Informational queries send 45.5% of citations to articles.
Statistics (+31%) and quotations (+41%) lift visibility — the education-content levers.

notes: Broadest intent class; wins on evidence density, not on covering every sub-keyword with a page.

name: Branded & reputation

aiExposure.unit: % of branded searches showing an AI Overview

evidence.finding: AI Overviews appear for 83% of branded searches — the answer about your brand is assembled mostly from third parties.
Branded web mentions correlate with AIO brand mentions at 0.664 — reputation work is mention work.

notes: You don't control the answer; you influence the sources it quotes. Review-platform accuracy is the actionable lever.

name: Local & near-me

aiExposure.unit: % of local-services queries with an AI Overview (vendor aggregation range 4–8%)

evidence.finding: Where a regional brand led, 46–59% of citations went to country-specific domains — local answers lean local sources.
Local intent resolves through business profiles and consistency signals; on-site copy alone cannot substitute.

notes: AI Overview exposure is lowest here, but map/assistant answers still fire for local intent — GBP and reviews are the levers.

name: News & current events

evidence.finding: Timely-query citation half-life is short (fitted ≈39 days; panel-relative half-life ~11 days) — recency is the product for news.
News & media sites keep 79.3% median coverage server-rendered yet block AI search crawlers at the highest rate (13 of 14) — a business-model tension, not a technical limit.

notes: Claude citations persist ~2.8× longer than ChatGPT's (Profound) — engine choice changes the economics of news freshness.

name: Navigational

aiExposure.unit: % of navigational keywords triggering AI Overviews

evidence.finding: Navigational keywords triggered AI Overviews 0% of the time in a 10K-keyword panel.

notes: No GEO play — but these are the queries where brand SERP hygiene (noindexed app routes, clean sitelinks) still matters.
